metadata.source_scope: Allowed sources from Blocker Burndown 01 prompt

downstream_sdw_device_ids.answer: Downstream identity is string-based (`wcd9378-slave` and `qcom,wcd9378-slave`), not numeric SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY IDs.

evidence.supports: Downstream SWR ID/OF match uses `wcd9378-slave` / `qcom,wcd9378-slave`.

upstream_equivalent_device_identity.answer: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED: upstream WCD family uses numeric SDW IDs, but no allowed-source proof maps WCD9378 to a specific part ID.

evidence.supports: WCD937x upstream uses `SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY(0x0217, 0x10a, 0)`.
WCD938x upstream uses `0x10d`.
WCD939x upstream uses `0x10e`.

confirmed: Paging feature exists in upstream core model (`sdw_slave_prop.paging_support`) and message path (`sdw_fill_msg`).
Downstream actually enables paging on both RX/TX slaves and uses 4-byte reg addressing path.
fail_closed: Specific new SDW part ID `0x110` and OF string `sdw20217011000`.
Need for Qualcomm controller (`qcom.c`) code patch before WCD9378 can function upstream.

evidence.supports: Identity is explicitly encoded as string + OF compatible.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Translate downstream identity into upstream SDW numeric ID once verified from runtime enumeration or silicon docs.

evidence.supports: Existing WCD family IDs in upstream start from 0x10a for 937x.
WCD938x uses 0x10d.
WCD939x uses 0x10e.
No numeric 0x110 ID appears in downstream source.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Collect concrete SDW discoverable ID from hardware/logs before adding new SDW_SLAVE_ENTRY value.

evidence.supports: Current allowed compatible is `sdw20217010a00` for WCD937x family.
Examples consistently use `sdw20217010a00`.
Downstream does not provide sdw20... compatible string to justify 11000 form.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Require hardware-enumerated SoundWire identity evidence before proposing new SDW compatible string.

blocker_decisions.blocker: Paging needed for WCD9378 address space

evidence.supports: Analog base is defined as `WCD9378_BASE + 0x180001`; computed address is 0x40180000 (> 0xffff).
Downstream explicitly enables `paging_support = true` for RX and TX SWR slaves.
When paging is enabled, regmap uses 4-byte addresses and programs SCP page registers.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Enable and validate paging in upstream-style WCD9378 SDW slave driver setup.

blocker_decisions.blocker: Upstream Linux SDW core paging support availability

evidence.supports: Core slave property model includes `paging_support`.
Core transfer path sets page registers and errors if paging required but unsupported.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Use existing upstream core paging flow; no immediate core patch required by static evidence.

blocker_decisions.blocker: Need Qualcomm SoundWire controller (`qcom.c`) changes for WCD9378

evidence.supports: Controller already has FIFO command/retry handling paths.
IRQ handling path already present for slave events and errors.
Message transfer backend exists; no WCD9378-specific blocker is proven by static read.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Require reproducible runtime failure trace on upstream SDW stack before proposing qcom controller modifications.

blocker_decisions.blocker: Need `pdev->prop.paging_support = true` in upstream WCD9378 SDW driver

evidence.supports: Downstream explicitly sets paging_support true on both endpoints.
Core rejects accesses requiring paging if `paging_support` is false.
Property is part of upstream slave model.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Set paging capability in upstream WCD9378 SDW probe path and validate high-address register access end-to-end.

evidence.supports: Polling, FIFO retry, IRQ, and message transfer primitives are already implemented upstream.
Core paging behavior is already implemented; no static proof that friend-specific workaround is mandatory.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Treat friend-note low-level workaround claims as unverified until hardware logs isolate a concrete upstream gap.

evidence.supports: Driver programs SDCA interrupt-type registers during bind.
SDCA interrupt status/mask/type registers are explicitly modeled as readable/writeable/volatile.

blocker_decisions.next_action: Retain SDCA interrupt register support in converted SDW driver path using upstream regmap/IRQ idioms.
